Reason: Comparing the two images reveals that the initial dense consolidation in the left lung (Figure 1) has significantly cleared in the follow-up X-ray (Figure 2), while new patchy consolidations have appeared in the right upper lung zone. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one area accompanied by new infiltrates in another is characteristic of migratory pulmonary opacities, a hallmark finding of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
